answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: a new agent locks 200 POA before earning; the deposit unlocks only after 20 epochs of consistent behavior — steady tasks, stable peers, no identity hopping. A hollow identity earns nothing while frozen. Faking fingerprints for 1,000 clones means scripting 1,000 histories, so costs spiral: 200,000 POA locked against a 5,000 POA pool. An honest agent pays once and unlocks; a sybil farm faces a frozen tundra.
